coverage.evidence: Spam defense sits in the settings.access group (dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:83-88, shown as Access at dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:961). Reading needs spam:policy:read at Mod level 10 (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/spam-defense/route.ts:22, server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54,426). Saving needs spam:policy:manage at Broadcaster level and can be granted (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:152-153,427, server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/SpamDefenseController.cs:91). Save is shown only when canManage (SpamDefenseView.vue:60). Without it the number boxes are disabled (dashboard/src/components/spam/SpamSettingsForm.vue:359,388) and switches become an EnabledState badge (dashboard/src/components/layout/GatedSwitch.vue:45-51).

All 22 defaults match server/src/NomNomzBot.Domain/Moderation/SpamDefense/SpamDefenseDefaults.cs, and every range matches the catalogue at SpamDefenseSettings.cs:243-298. The server checks ranges, the exoneration share, the open-group cap and the lockdown cap (SpamDefenseService.cs:879-965). The form checks the same pairs and names them under the setting (SpamSettingsForm.vue:185-265). The trust fields only check for blank or negative and show no local reason (SpamSettingsForm.vue:224-226,381). Save stays off until a change (SpamDefenseView.vue:63) and sends the whole record (SpamSettingsForm.vue:288-295). The texts Unsaved changes and Spam defense saved are at spam-defense/i18n/en.json:9-10. An untouched channel follows the platform defaults (SpamDefenseService.cs:82-106).

The seven-day window is SpamObservationWindow.cs:24-57. Its fallback uses Channel.CreatedAt, not BotJoinedAt (SpamObservationWindow.cs:41-46, server/src/NomNomzBot.Domain/Identity/Entities/Channel.cs:133). A channel that had spam defense off starts the seven days at the save (SpamDefenseService.cs:131-135). The viewer-selling exception holds unless the channel's own row has DryRun true (SpamDefenseService.cs:444-450,841-842). It becomes a direct ban on Twitch that skips the ladder (SpamEnforcementExecutor.cs:120-127). Established and protected viewers never reach it (SpamEnforcement.cs Decide immune and shielded branches). Actions are signed by the channel owner or the moderator who is live (SpamEnforcementExecutor.cs:243-246). Disabled means no evaluation (SpamDefenseService.cs:416).

Established requires days, messages, active days and strike-free days (TrustTierLadder.cs:225-235). The strike-free check is hard-coded to double.MaxValue (SpamDefenseService.cs:754), so it always passes. A VIP becomes Established only without a low-trust flag (SpamDefenseService.cs:715-716). Owner-moderated Twitch senders become Trusted (SpamDefenseService.cs:718-727). A restricted flag forces Untrusted and active monitoring caps at Newcomer (TrustTierLadder.cs:134-140), which also overrides watch-hour protection (AccountRisk.cs:227-236). The two watch-hour values cover this channel and all channels (SpamDefenseService.cs:759-766). Protected viewers get delete and queue only (TrustTierLadder.cs:248-249). The newcomer gate exempts Regular and above, unknown account ages and non-followers (AccountAgeGate.cs). A message is queued only when it was really deleted (AccountAgeGateExecutor.cs:85-88). The non-Latin floor is Regular and lifts confidence to Medium at most (CapabilityGate.cs:39-48,97-103).

A group qualifies on minimum size and stranger share, is exonerated below the exoneration share, and that exoneration is one-way (CampaignCohort.cs:170-194). Action waits for the head start (CampaignCohort.cs:213). The reversal is issued only on the flip and only when auto-undo is on (SpamCorrelationService.cs:122-128). It covers only accounts whose timeout or ban the platform confirmed (SpamDefenseHandler.cs:181-191). It unbans only (SpamCampaignReversalExecutor.cs:112-120), so deleted messages are not restored. The page makes no claim about Home, and the dashboard has no detections or campaigns screen (no consumer of spam-defense/detections or campaigns under dashboard/src beyond schema.d.ts).

reader_answers.evidence: The eight groups are the i18n groups at admin/i18n/en.json (spamDefaults.groups), and the form renders one card per group (SpamSettingsForm.vue:140-153,326-333). The six pending settings are SpamDefenseSettings.cs:262-296. Join rate and the shared list switches have no reader outside the entity mapping (grep). The lockdown values are read only by LockdownService.cs:212-215,285, whose only engage caller is SpamDefenseController.cs:297.
Manage is Broadcaster level with grant allowed (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:427,152-153). Read is Mod level (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:426), and Save shows only with manage (SpamDefenseView.vue:60).

Unsaved changes shows when the form is dirty (SpamDefenseView.vue:56-57). The success toast is Spam defense saved (SpamDefenseView.vue:46, i18n/en.json:9). Out-of-range values disable Save (SpamDefenseView.vue:63, SpamSettingsForm.vue:228-233) with the outOfRange text (SpamSettingsForm.vue:259-263).

Save needs dirty (SpamDefenseView.vue:63), the body carries every setting including dryRun (SpamSettingsForm.vue:288-295), and a stored DryRun true ends the exception (SpamDefenseService.cs:444-447,841-842).
